thread:
mira.marketing: Heads-up — Nimbus Labs is willing to do a short case writeup + a 20s demo clip. They asked if we can hold publication under embargo for 48 hours and want to approve the hero quote. Need legal and product to confirm approval flow.

frank.cs: Great. We need explicit confirmation of test conditions (dataset size, prod vs. staging, run length). Also ask them whether they want any sensitive metrics redacted.

zara.pm: For routing, let's gate inbound leads to the webinar first then route conversions to AE with UTM=nimbus_campaign. @signup-bot can we create that funnel?

signup-bot: Funnel created: registration -> nurture (3 emails) -> MQL check -> AE assignment (Regional queue). UTM param set: utm_campaign=nimbus_campaign.

leo.legal: For embargo and quote: we need a one-line email from Nimbus: "We confirm these performance figures and grant Redwood permission to use Nimbus Labs' name and logo on web and social. We request a 48-hour embargo and reserve the right to review final copy." That will be sufficient. Also request logo usage scope and brand kit.

anya.design: If they give a 20s clip we can produce a 15s vertical for socials and a 4:5 hero for the landing. Need SVG/PNG logo and any brand color constraints.

mira.marketing: I'll ask for the exact wording, logo, brand kit, and whether they prefer quote attribution to company or a person (CTO/Head of ML). Also proposing the quote draft to speed approvals: 

mira.marketing: ```
"Nimbus Labs reduced inference tail latency by 60% and lowered per-request cost, enabling us to serve more customers with the same team."
```

frank.cs: That sounds okay but ask them to confirm the 60% number and whether it's median or p95. If they can't provide specifics, we'll label it "customer-reported".

zara.pm: Proposed timeline: T+0 get assets and confirmation, T+1 internal review and design, T+2 embargo window ends -> publish + webinar registration open. Works?

leo.legal: Sounds fine. If Nimbus requires changes, we'll include a note. Also ask if they want a pre-publish review of the landing page (24h).

mira.marketing: Reached out to Nimbus with: quote draft, request for confirmation wording, logo, brand kit, embargo request, and whether they want pre-publish review. Will paste reply here.

(3h later)
mira.marketing: Nimbus replied: "Confirmed — the 60% is p95 on our production traffic averaged over a 10-day run. You have permission to use our name and logo on web and social. We request a 48-hour embargo and a 24-hour pre-publish review of the landing page. Attached: nimbus-lockup.svg, brand-guidelines.pdf"

leo.legal: Good. That meets our checklist. Please paste their confirmation text into the PR and attach the assets. Consider the quote approved pending the 24h review; we'll give final sign-off after they confirm the landing copy.

anya.design: Got the SVG and guidelines. I'll start hero + vertical cut. Will post initial comps for review in the PR.

zara.pm: I'll set the UTM and funnel to go live on publish. Also adding a hidden field on the registration form to tag Nimbus-interest so AE queue can filter.

signup-bot: Hidden field added: product_interest=nimbus. AE routing confirmed.

mira.marketing: Perfect. I'll open the PR with landing copy + assets and tag everyone for review. Please approve or request changes in the PR so we can honor the 24h pre-publish review. :rocket:
